{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_0bc7e93ac89347c1bc10264e","type":"tool_result","content":"4040\t\n4041\t# Phase 6: Pluck Telemetry Isolation, Fleet Process Tracking, and Concurrent-Dispatch Safety\n4042\t\n4043\t**Status:** planned (ADR-002; §6.5/§6.6 found after ADR-002 was written, not yet their own ADR).\n4044\t\n4045\t**Goal:** stop Pluck's own operational confusion from leaking into a target repo as fabricated work, make `needle stop`/`needle status`/`needle list` trustworthy enough to use during incident response without a manual `ps aux` cross-check, make the fleet's own failure-handling strands (Splice, Unravel) actually catch a worker that's stuck retrying a human-gated bead forever, and make it safe for two workers to share one workspace without racing on git state. Driven by an 8-day incident on `~/ARMOR` (2026-07-06 through 2026-07-14): a Pluck starvation self-diagnostic was written as a bead into ARMOR's own tracker, could never legitimately resolve (its \"fix\" target was NEEDLE's own config, unreachable from ARMOR), and the unresolved loop spiraled into 346 fabricated beads and ~2,300 wasted bead-cycles across two workers over 8 days — one of which (`bravo`) kept running after `needle stop` reported success, and a third (`alpha`) was invisible to `needle status`/`needle list` entirely. Full evidence and rationale in [ADR-002](../adr/002-pluck-telemetry-isolation-and-process-tracking.md). Two same-day follow-up checks found further gaps: why didn't Splice/Unravel stop this class of incident on their own (§6.5), and whether it's actually safe to run two workers in one workspace at all (§6.6).\n4046\t\n4047\t## Changes\n4048\t\n4049\t### 6.1 Pluck telemetry isolation\n4050\t- **Redirect the starvation self-diagnostic to NEEDLE's own telemetry.** `PluckStrand` (`src/strand/pluck.rs`) must never write a bead into the workspace it is scanning. Emit a `pluck.starvation_detected` event through the existing telemetry pipeline instead, with workspace path, open/excluded counts, and candidate exclusion reasons.\n4051\t- **If a persistent record is needed, file it in NEEDLE's own workspace**, never the target's — apply the same isolation rule anywhere else Pluck (or any strand) might be tempted to write its own operational state as a bead in a scanned repo.\n4052\t- **Filter target-repo auto-decomposition for NEEDLE-internal work.** A worker dispatched against a target repo should never be prompted to \"investigate/fix Pluck configuration\" or equivalent — that class of task has no legitimate resolution path from inside the target repo and should be recognized and rejected at decomposition time, not left to spiral.\n4053\t\n4054\t### 6.2 Fleet process tracking\n4055\t- **`needle stop` kills the full process tree.** Parent `needle run` process, its `bash -c` prompt wrapper, and the dispatched `claude` subprocess — not just the tmux registry entry. Verify the PID is actually gone before reporting success.\n4056\t- **`needle status`/`needle list` must have no blind spots.** Every live `needle run --workspace ...` process must be discoverable through standard fleet commands regardless of how it was started (tmux-wrapped or bare background). Add a reconciliation check (registry view vs. `ps aux` process-table view) that WARNs on any unregistered `needle run` process.\n4057\t\n4058\t### 6.5 Splice/Unravel loop-detection gap\n4059\tFound investigating whether the fleet's own failure-handling strands activated during the 2026-07-14 ARMOR (`bf-34xw9`) and Commitgraph (`bf-39by`) retry-storm incidents (both: a worker retrying a human-gated-access bead forever). They didn't — confirmed via telemetry (`bf-34xw9`: 41 `bead.claim.succeeded`, 25 `bead.orphaned`, 42 `agent.completed`, only 1 real `bead.completed`, over 24h) and code review, for three compounding reasons:\n4060\t- **Detector blind spot.** `SpliceStrand::detect_claim_churn` only counts `bead.claim.race_lost` — this pattern is claim-succeeded-then-orphaned-then-reclaimed, a different signal no detector reads. `detect_state_ping_pong` and `detect_log_runaway` both gate on \"no `agent.completed`/`bead.completed` event in the scan window\" as their definition of no-forward-progress; a bead that completes an agent run 42 times without ever closing looks identical to real progress under this check, so both are permanently blind to this exact failure mode.\n4061\t- **Missing config.** `document_failure`/`document_live_loop` silently no-op if `strands.splice.report_workspace` is unset — no bead, just a debug log line. The lab deployment's config has every other strand's section except `splice`'s, so this defaulted to `None` the whole time (confirmed: 455 `strand.evaluated` events fleet-wide in 24h, zero escalation beads created).\n4062\t- **No connection back to the stuck bead.** Even when `document_live_loop` works as designed, it only creates a *new* side-report bead (`[\"worker-loop\", \"human\"]`) in the report workspace — it never labels the original stuck bead itself. Pluck excludes `human`-labeled beads and Unravel only acts on them (§6.1's third bullet); a working Splice detection still wouldn't stop Pluck from redispatching the actual stuck bead, and Unravel would never see it.\n4063\t\n4064\tFix: a new detector for repeated claim+orphan cycles with high completion-without-resolution count; make `report_workspace` a validated, loudly-WARNed-if-missing config value; and have Splice label the *original* bead `human` directly when it detects a live loop, not just file a side report.\n4065\t\n4066\t### 6.6 Bead-Id trailer race under concurrent same-workspace dispatch\n4067\tFound evaluating whether it's safe to dispatch a second worker into `~/NEEDLE` alongside `charlie`, same workspace, same branch. `commit_hook::inject_bead_id_trailer` (`src/commit_hook.rs`) runs `git commit --amend --no-edit --trailer Bead-Id:X` on whatever commit is at HEAD after a successful dispatch. Its only safety check (`src/worker/mod.rs:2079`) is `current_head != pre_dispatch_head` — it never verifies the commit actually at HEAD is the one its own agent produced. Each `needle run` is a fully separate OS process with no lock or mutex between them, so nothing coordinates this across two workers sharing a workspace.\n4068\t\n4069\tRace: worker A commits (HEAD=A1); before A reaches the trailer step, worker B also commits (HEAD=B1, on top of A1); A's check (`current_head(B1) != pre_dispatch_head(base)`) passes, so A amends B1 — rewriting its hash and mislabeling B's actual diff as belonging to bead A. This corrupts HOOP's `bead_commit_index` (the reason this trailer exists at all) and invalidates worker B's own subsequent bookkeeping. ADR).\n\n**Goal:** stop Pluck's own operational confusion from leaking into a target repo as fabricated work, make `needle stop`/`needle status`/`needle list` trustworthy enough to use during incident response without a manual `ps aux` cross-check, make the fleet's own failure-handling strands (Splice, Unravel) actually catch a worker that's stuck retrying a human-gated bead forever, and make it safe for two workers to share one workspace without racing on git state. Driven by an 8-day incident on `~/ARMOR` (2026-07-06 through 2026-07-14): a Pluck starvation self-diagnostic was written as a bead into ARMOR's own tracker, could never legitimately resolve (its \"fix\" target was NEEDLE's own config, unreachable from ARMOR), and the unresolved loop spiraled into 346 fabricated beads and ~2,300 wasted bead-cycles across two workers over 8 days — one of which (`bravo`) kept running after `needle stop` reported success, and a third (`alpha`) was invisible to `needle status`/`needle list` entirely. Full evidence and rationale in [ADR-002](../adr/002-pluck-telemetry-isolation-and-process-tracking.md). Two same-day follow-up checks found further gaps: why didn't Splice/Unravel stop this class of incident on their own (§6.5), and whether it's actually safe to run two workers in one workspace at all (§6.6).\n\n## Changes\n\n### 6.1 Pluck telemetry isolation\n- **Redirect the starvation self-diagnostic to NEEDLE's own telemetry.** `PluckStrand` (`src/strand/pluck.rs`) must never write a bead into the workspace it is scanning. Emit a `pluck.starvation_detected` event through the existing telemetry pipeline instead, with workspace path, open/excluded counts, and candidate exclusion reasons.\n- **If a persistent record is needed, file it in NEEDLE's own workspace**, never the target's — apply the same isolation rule anywhere else Pluck (or any strand) might be tempted to write its own operational state as a bead in a scanned repo.\n- **Filter target-repo auto-decomposition for NEEDLE-internal work.** A worker dispatched against a target repo should never be prompted to \"investigate/fix Pluck configuration\" or equivalent — that class of task has no legitimate resolution path from inside the target repo and should be recognized and rejected at decomposition time, not left to spiral.\n\n### 6.2 Fleet process tracking\n- **`needle stop` kills the full process tree.** Parent `needle run` process, its `bash -c` prompt wrapper, and the dispatched `claude` subprocess — not just the tmux registry entry. Verify the PID is actually gone before reporting success.\n- **`needle status`/`needle list` must have no blind spots.** Every live `needle run --workspace ...` process must be discoverable through standard fleet commands regardless of how it was started (tmux-wrapped or bare background). Add a reconciliation check (registry view vs. `ps aux` process-table view) that WARNs on any unregistered `needle run` process.\n\n### 6.5 Splice/Unravel loop-detection gap\nFound investigating whether the fleet's own failure-handling strands activated during the 2026-07-14 ARMOR (`bf-34xw9`) and Commitgraph (`bf-39by`) retry-storm incidents (both: a worker retrying a human-gated-access bead forever). They didn't — confirmed via telemetry (`bf-34xw9`: 41 `bead.claim.succeeded`, 25 `bead.orphaned`, 42 `agent.completed`, only 1 real `bead.completed`, over 24h) and code review, for three compounding reasons:\n- **Detector blind spot.** `SpliceStrand::detect_claim_churn` only counts `bead.claim.race_lost` — this pattern is claim-succeeded-then-orphaned-then-reclaimed, a different signal no detector reads. `detect_state_ping_pong` and `detect_log_runaway` both gate on \"no `agent.completed`/`bead.completed` event in the scan window\" as their definition of no-forward-progress; a bead that completes an agent run 42 times without ever closing looks identical to real progress under this check, so both are permanently blind to this exact failure mode.\n- **Missing config.** `document_failure`/`document_live_loop` silently no-op if `strands.splice.report_workspace` is unset — no bead, just a debug log line. The lab deployment's config has every other strand's section except `splice`'s, so this defaulted to `None` the whole time (confirmed: 455 `strand.evaluated` events fleet-wide in 24h, zero escalation beads created).\n- **No connection back to the stuck bead.** Even when `document_live_loop` works as designed, it only creates a *new* side-report bead (`[\"worker-loop\", \"human\"]`) in the report workspace — it never labels the original stuck bead itself. Pluck excludes `human`-labeled beads and Unravel only acts on them (§6.1's third bullet); a working Splice detection still wouldn't stop Pluck from redispatching the actual stuck bead, and Unravel would never see it.\n\nFix: a new detector for repeated claim+orphan cycles with high completion-without-resolution count; make `report_workspace` a validated, loudly-WARNed-if-missing config value; and have Splice label the *original* bead `human` directly when it detects a live loop, not just file a side report.\n\n### 6.6 Bead-Id trailer race under concurrent same-workspace dispatch\nFound evaluating whether it's safe to dispatch a second worker into `~/NEEDLE` alongside `charlie`, same workspace, same branch. `commit_hook::inject_bead_id_trailer` (`src/commit_hook.rs`) runs `git commit --amend --no-edit --trailer Bead-Id:X` on whatever commit is at HEAD after a successful dispatch. Its only safety check (`src/worker/mod.rs:2079`) is `current_head != pre_dispatch_head` — it never verifies the commit actually at HEAD is the one its own agent produced. Each `needle run` is a fully separate OS process with no lock or mutex between them, so nothing coordinates this across two workers sharing a workspace.\n\nRace: worker A commits (HEAD=A1); before A reaches the trailer step, worker B also commits (HEAD=B1, on top of A1); A's check (`current_head(B1) != pre_dispatch_head(base)`) passes, so A amends B1 — rewriting its hash and mislabeling B's actual diff as belonging to bead A.      if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n505\t            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n506\t        }\n507\t    }\n508\t\n509\t    // Try to find a bare JSON object.\n510\t    let trimmed = text.trim();\n511\t    if trimmed.starts_with('{') {\n512\t        // Find matching closing brace (simple heuristic).\n513\t        let mut depth = 0i32;\n514\t        for (i, ch) in trimmed.char_indices() {\n515\t            match ch {\n516\t                '{' => depth += 1,\n517\t                '}' => {\n518\t                    depth -= 1;\n519\t                    if depth == 0 {\n520\t                        return Some(&trimmed[..=i]);\n521\t                    }\n522\t                }\n523\t                _ => {}\n524\t            }\n525\t        }\n526\t    }\n527\t\n528\t    None\n529\t}\n530\t\n531\t/// Sanitize a path string for use as a filename component.\n532\tfn sanitize_path_component(s: &str) -> String {\n533\t    s.chars()\n534\t        .map(|c| {\n535\t            if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' {\n536\t                c\n537\t            } else {\n538\t                '_'\n539\t            }\n540\t        })\n541\t        .collect()\n542\t}\n543\t\n544\t/// Check if two titles match (fuzzy comparison for dedup).\n545\t///\n546\t/// Considers titles matching if they are identical after normalization,\n547\t/// or if one contains the other as a substring.\n548\tfn titles_match(existing: &str, proposed: &str) -> bool {\n549\t    if existing == proposed {\n550\t        return true;\n551\t    }\n552\t\n553\t    // Normalize: remove common prefixes and compare.\n554\t    let normalize = |s: &str| -> String {\n555\t        s.trim()\n556\t            .trim_start_matches(|c: char| !c.is_alphabetic())\n557\t            .to_lowercase()\n558\t    };\n559\t\n560\t    let e = normalize(existing);\n561\t    let p = normalize(proposed);\n562\t\n563\t    e == p || e.contains(&p) || p.contains(&e)\n564\t}\n565\t\n566\t/// Detect if a bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration.\n567\t///\n568\t/// Returns true if the bead content suggests investigating or fixing NEEDLE's own\n569\t/// dispatch configuration (Pluck, exclude_labels, bead discovery, etc.).\n570\t/// These tasks have no legitimate resolution path from inside a target repo.\n571\tpub fn detects_needle_internal_config(bead: &Bead) -> bool {\n572\t    let combined_text = format!(\n573\t        \"{} {}\",\n574\t        bead.title.to_lowercase(),\n575\t        bead.body\n576\t            .as_ref()\n577\t            .map(|b| b.to_lowercase())\n578\t            .unwrap_or_default()\n579\t    );\n580\t\n581\t    // Patterns that indicate NEEDLE-internal configuration work.\n582\t    //       \"exclude_labels\",\n587\t        \"exclude labels\",\n588\t        \"bead discovery\",\n589\t        \"starvation alert\",\n590\t        \"beads invisible to worker\",\n591\t        \"open beads exist but pluck found none\",\n592\t        \"needle dispatch\",\n593\t        \"strand configuration\",\n594\t        \"worker configuration\",\n595\t        \"bead filtering\",\n596\t        \"candidate exclusion\",\n597\t    ];\n598\t\n599\t    for pattern in &internal_config_patterns {\n600\t        if combined_text.contains(pattern) {\n601\t            tracing::debug!(\n602\t                bead_id = %bead.id,\n603\t                pattern,\n604\t                \"bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration\"\n605\t            );\n606\t            return true;\n607\t Mitosis: split multi-task beads into focused children on first failure.\n//!\n//! Uses child-aware deduplication to prevent duplicate splits. The parent's\n//! existing children serve as the dedup source — if children already cover\n//! a proposed task, that child is skipped.\n//!\n//! Concurrency safety: a per-workspace flock serializes the entire mitosis\n//! operation (read children → create → link dependencies).\n//!\n//! Depends on: `bead_store`, `config`, `dispatch`, `prompt`, `telemetry`, `types`, `claim`.\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\n\nuse crate::bead_store::BeadStore;\nuse crate::claim::acquire_flock;\nuse crate::config::MitosisConfig;\nuse crate::dispatch::Dispatcher;\nuse crate::prompt::PromptBuilder;\nuse crate::telemetry::{EventKind, Telemetry};\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId};\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// MitosisResult\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Outcome of a mitosis evaluation.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum MitosisResult {\n    /// Bead was split into child beads.\n    Split {\n        /// IDs of the newly created children.\n        children: Vec<BeadId>,\n    },\n    /// Agent determined the bead is a single task — no split.\n    NotSplittable,\n    /// Mitosis was skipped (disabled, not first failure, etc.).\n    Skipped { reason: String },\n    /// Bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration and is out-of-scope for target workspace.\n    OutOfScope,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ProposedChild\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A child bead proposed by the agent during mitosis analysis.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct ProposedChild {\n    title: String,\n    body: String,\n}\n\n/// Agent's mitosis analysis response.\n#[derive(Debug, serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct MitosisResponse {\n    splittable: bool,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    children: Vec<ProposedChild>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// MitosisEvaluator\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Evaluates beads for splitting and creates child beads when appropriate.\npub struct MitosisEvaluator {\n    config: MitosisConfig,\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n    lock_dir: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl MitosisEvaluator {\n    pub fn new(config: MitosisConfig, telemetry: Telemetry, lock_dir: PathBuf) -> Self {\n        MitosisEvaluator {\n            config,\n            telemetry,\n            lock_dir,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Evaluate a bead for mitosis after failure.\n    ///\n    /// Checks preconditions (enabled, first failure), then dispatches the agent\n    /// to analyze whether the bead contains multiple independent tasks.\n    /// If splittable, creates child beads with dedup against existing &PromptBuilder,\n        agent_name: &str,\n    ) -> Result<MitosisResult> {\n        // Check if mitosis is enabled.\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"mitosis disabled\");\n            return Ok(MitosisResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"disabled\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Check if bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration.\n        // These tasks have no legitimate resolution path from inside a target repo.\n        if detects_needle_internal_config(bead) {\n            tracing::info!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                title = %bead.title,\n                \"mitosis skipped: bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration\"\n            );\n            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisOutOfScope {\n                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n            })?;\n            return Ok(MitosisResult::OutOfScope);\n        }\n\n        // Check failure count conditions.\n        let failure_count = self.get_failure_count(store, &bead.id).await?;\n\n        // force_failure_threshold: trigger only when failure_count reaches the threshold.\n        if self.config.force_failure_threshold > 0 {\n            if failure_count < self.config.force_failure_threshold {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    failure_count,\n                    threshold = self.config.force_failure_threshold,\n                    \"mitosis skipped: below force_failure_threshold\"\n                );\n                return Ok(MitosisResult::Skipped {\n                    reason: format!(\n                        \"failure count {} below threshold {}\",\n                        failure_count, self.config.force_failure_threshold\n                    ),\n                });\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check if we should fire based on first_failure_only or repeat_interval.\n            let should_fire = if self.config.repeat_interval > 0 {\n                // repeat_interval mode: fire at 1, 1+N, 1+2N, ...\n                // But skip beads that are already mitosis children (have mitosis-depth label).\n                let has_mitosis_depth_label =\n                    bead.labels.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with(\"mitosis-depth:\"));\n                let is_repeat_tick =\n                    failure_count > 1 && (failure_count - 1) % self.config.repeat_interval == 0;\n\n                // Fire at first failure OR at repeat interval ticks (if not a mitosis child)\n                failure_count == 1 || (is_repeat_tick && !has_mitosis_depth_label)\n            } else {\n                // first_failure_only mode: only fire at failure_count == 1\n                !self.config.first_failure_only || failure_count == 1\n            };\n\n            if !should_fire {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    failure_count,\n                    first_failure_only = self.config.first_failure_only,\n                    repeat_interval = self.config.repeat_interval,\n                    \"mitosis skipped: not at trigger point\"\n                );\n                return Ok(MitosisResult::Skipped {\n                    reason: format!(\n                        \"not at trigger point (count={}, first_failure_only={}, repeat_interval={})\",\n                        failure_count, self.config.first_failure_only, self.config.repeat_interval\n                    ),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Resolve the agent adapter.\n        let adapter = match dispatcher.adapter(agent_name) {\n            Some(a) => a,\n            None => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    agent = agent_name,\n                    \"mitosis skipped: agent adapter not found\"\n                );\n                return Ok(MitosisResult::Skipped {\n                    reason: format!(\"adapter '{}' not found\", agent_name),\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Gather existing children for the prompt (so the agent avoids duplicates).\n        let existing_children = self.get_existing_children(store, &bead.id).await?;\n        let existing_children_text = if existing_children.is_empty() {\n            \"(no existing children)\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            existing_children\n                .iter()\n                .map(|t| format!(\"- {t}\"))\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        // Build mitosis prompt.\n        let prompt = prompt_builder\n            .build_mitosis(bead, workspace, \"mitosis\", &existing_children_text)\n            .context(\"failed to build mitosis prompt\")?;\n\n        // Acquire workspace flock for atomicity.\n        let lock_path = self.lock_dir.join(format!(\n            \"needle-mitosis-{}.lock\",\n            sanitize_path_component(&workspace.display().to_string())\n        ));\n        let _lock = acquire_flock(&lock_path)\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to acquire mitosis flock\")?;\n\n        tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"dispatching agent for mitosis analysis\");\n\n        // Dispatch agent with mitosis prompt.\n        let exec_result = dispatcher\n            .dispatch(&bead.id, &prompt, adapter, workspace)\n            .await\n            .context(\"mitosis agent dispatch failed\")?;\n\n        // Parse the agent's response.\n        let response = parse_mitosis_response(&exec_result.stdout);\n\n        match response {\n            Some(resp) if resp.splittable && !resp.children.is_empty() => {\n                self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisEvaluated {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    splittable: true,\n                    proposed_children: resp.children.len() as u32,\n                })?;\n\n                self.create_children(store, bead, &resp.children).await\n            }\n            Some(resp) if resp.splittable => {\n                // Splittable but no children proposed — treat as not splittable.\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"agent said splittable but proposed no children\"\n                );\n                self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisEvaluated {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    splittable: false,\n                    proposed_children: 0,\n                })?;\n                Ok(MitosisResult::NotSplittable)\n            }\n            Some(_) => {\n                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"agent determined bead is single task\");\n                self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisEvaluated {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    splittable: false,\n                    proposed_children: 0,\n                })?;\n                Ok(MitosisResult::NotSplittable)\n            }\n            None => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    exit_code = exec_result.exit_code,\n                    \"could not parse mitosis response from agent\"\n                );\n                self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisEvaluated {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    splittable: false,\n                    proposed_children: 0,\n                })?;\n                Ok(MitosisResult::NotSplittable)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create child beads with dedup against existing children.\n    async fn create_children(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        parent: &Bead,\n        proposed: &[ProposedChild],\n    ) -> Result<MitosisResult> {\n        // Enter the bead.mitosis span for the mitosis operation.\n        let mitosis_span = tracing::info_span!(\n            \"bead.mitosis\",\n            needle.bead.id = %parent.id,\n            needle.mitosis.proposed_children = proposed.len() as u32,\n            needle.mitosis.children_created = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on result\n            needle.mitosis.children_skipped = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on result\n        );\n        let _mitosis_enter = mitosis_span.enter();\n\n        // Read parent's existing children (dependencies where child blocks parent).\n        let existing = self.get_existing_children(store, &parent.id).await?;\n        let existing_titles: Vec<String> = existing.iter().map(|t| t.to_lowercase()).collect();\n\n        let mut created_ids = Vec::new();\n        let mut skipped = 0u32;\n\n        for child in proposed {\n            // Dedup: does an existing child cover this task?\n            if existing_titles\n                .iter()\n                .any(|t| titles_match(t, &child.title.to_lowercase()))\n            {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    parent_id = %parent.id,\n                    child_title = %child.title,\n                    \"skipping duplicate child\"\n                );\n                skipped += 1;\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Create child bead with parent-tracking labels for reliable dedup.\n            // Labels are stored on the bead itself and survive FrankenSQLite\n            // index corruption, unlike dependency relationships.\n            let parent_label = format!(\"parent-{}\", parent.id);\n            let labels: Vec<&str> = vec![\"mitosis-child\", \"mitosis-depth:1\", &parent_label];\n            let child_id = store\n                .create_bead(&child.title, &child.body, &labels)\n                .await\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create child bead: {}\", child.title))?;\n\n            // Link child as blocking parent.\n            store\n                .add_dependency(&child_id, &parent.id)\n                .await\n                .with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"failed to add dependency: {} blocks {}\",\n                        child_id, parent.id\n                    )\n                })?;\n\n            tracing::info!(\n                parent_id = %parent.id,\n                child_id = %child_id,\n                child_title = %child.title,\n                \"created mitosis child\"\n            );\n\n            created_ids.push(child_id);\n        }\n\n        if created_ids.is_empty() {\n            // All proposed children already existed.\n            tracing::info!(\n                parent_id = %parent.id,\n                existing = existing.len(),\n                \"all proposed children already exist (dedup)\"\n            );\n            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisSkipped {\n                parent_id: parent.id.clone(),\n                existing_children: existing.len() as u32,\n            })?;\n            return Ok(MitosisResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"all children already exist\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisSplit {\n            parent_id: parent.id.clone(),\n            children_created: created_ids.len() as u32,\n            children_skipped: skipped,\n            child_ids: created_ids.clone(),\n        })?;\n\n        // Record the final counts on the bead.mitosis span\n        tracing::Span::current()\n            .record(\"needle.mitosis.children_created\", created_ids.len() as u32);\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.mitosis.children_skipped\", skipped);\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            parent_id = %parent.id,\n            children_created = created_ids.len(),\n            children_skipped = skipped,\n            \"mitosis split completed\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(MitosisResult::Split {\n            children: created_ids,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Read the failure count label from a bead.\n    ///\n    /// All br calls are wrapped in timeouts to prevent indefinite hang.\n    async fn get_failure_count(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, bead_id: &BeadId) -> Result<u32> {\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(bead_id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) => l,\n                Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead_id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to read labels for failure count\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead_id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, assuming failure count 0\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n            };\n\n        let count = labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        Ok(count)\n    }\n\n    /// Get titles of existing children for a parent bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses label-based discovery (`parent-<parent_id>` label) instead of\n    /// reading the parent's dependency list. This is robust against\n    /// FrankenSQLite index corruption where `br dep add` creates the\n    /// dependency link and labels but the relationship doesn't appear in\n    /// `br show --json` output.\n    ///\n    /// The `list_all()` call is wrapped in a timeout to prevent indefinite\n    /// hang in HANDLING state.\n    async fn get_existing_children(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        parent_id: &BeadId,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let parent_label = format!(\"parent-{}\", parent_id);\n        let all_beads = match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.list_all(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(beads)) => beads,\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    parent_id = %parent_id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"list_all failed during get_existing_children, assuming no children\"\n                );\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    parent_id = %parent_id,\n                    \"list_all timed out after 30s during get_existing_children, assuming no children\"\n                );\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n        };\n\n        let titles: Vec<String> = all_beads\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| l == &parent_label))\n            .map(|b| b.title.clone())\n            .collect();\n\n        Ok(titles)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Parsing\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Parse the agent's mitosis analysis response from stdout.\n///\n/// Searches for a JSON object in the output. Handles markdown code fencing\n/// and surrounding text.\nfn parse_mitosis_response(stdout: &str) -> Option<MitosisResponse> {\n    // Try direct JSON parse first.\n    if let Ok(resp) = serde_json::from_str::<MitosisResponse>(stdout.trim()) {\n        return Some(resp);\n    }\n\n    // Try extracting JSON from markdown code fences.\n    let json_str = extract_json_block(stdout)?;\n    serde_json::from_str::<MitosisResponse>(json_str).ok()\n}\n\n/// Extract a JSON object from text that may contain markdown code fences.\nfn extract_json_block(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    // Look for ```json ... ``` or ``` ... ``` blocks.\n    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```json\") {\n        let content_start = start + \"```json\".len();\n        if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```\") {\n        let content_start = start + \"```\".len();\n        // Skip to next line if the opening ``` has text after it.\n        let content_start = text[content_start..]\n            .find('\\n')\n            .map(|n| content_start + n + 1)\n            .unwrap_or(content_start);\n        if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Try to find a bare JSON object.\n    let trimmed = text.trim();\n    if trimmed.starts_with('{') {\n        // Find matching closing brace (simple heuristic).\n        let mut depth = 0i32;\n        for (i, ch) in trimmed.char_indices() {\n            match ch {\n                '{' => depth += 1,\n                '}' => {\n                    depth -= 1;\n                    if depth == 0 {\n                        return Some(&trimmed[..=i]);\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    None\n}\n\n/// Sanitize a path string for use as a filename component.\nfn sanitize_path_component(s: &str) -> String {\n    s.chars()\n        .map(|c| {\n            if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' {\n                c\n            } else {\n                '_'\n            }\n        })\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// Check if two titles match (fuzzy comparison for dedup).\n///\n/// Considers titles matching if they are identical after normalization,\n/// or if one contains the other as a substring.\nfn titles_match(existing: &str, proposed: &str) -> bool {\n    if existing == proposed {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Normalize: remove common prefixes and compare.\n    let normalize = |s: &str| -> String {\n        s.trim()\n            .trim_start_matches(|c: char| !c.is_alphabetic())\n            .to_lowercase()\n    };\n\n    let e = normalize(existing);\n    let p = normalize(proposed);\n\n    e == p || e.contains(&p) || p.contains(&e)\n}\n\n/// Detect if a bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration.\n///\n/// Returns true if the bead content suggests investigating or fixing NEEDLE's own\n/// dispatch configuration (Pluck, exclude_labels, bead discovery, etc.).\n/// These tasks have no legitimate resolution path from inside a target repo.\npub fn detects_needle_internal_config(bead: &Bead) -> bool {\n    let combined_text = format!(\n        \"{} {}\",\n        bead.title.to_lowercase(),\n        bead.body\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|b| b.to_lowercase())\n            .unwrap_or_default()\n    );\n\n    // Patterns that indicate NEEDLE-internal configuration work.\n    // These are derived from the real ARMOR incident (bead bf-3b64 and its lineage).\n    let internal_config_patterns = [\n        \"pluck configuration\",\n        \"pluck config\",\n        \"exclude_labels\",\n        \"exclude labels\",\n        \"bead discovery\",\n        \"starvation alert\",\n        \"beads invisible to worker\",\n        \"open beads exist but pluck found none\",\n        \"needle dispatch\",\n        \"strand configuration\",\n        \"worker configuration\",\n        \"bead filtering\",\n        \"candidate exclusion\",\n    ];\n\n    for pattern in &internal_config_patterns {\n        if combined_text.contains(pattern) {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                pattern,\n                \"bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration\"\n            );\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    false\n}\n\n//
